speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever (RMSF) with secondary exanthem or Early Measles (Rubeola), pending CBC and imaging confirmation. Given the "worst case" urgency and the specific mention of a facial rash sparing the perioral area after a viral prodrome, please ensure immediate isolation and empiric treatment while awaiting my requested images and blood work.
